title: Prepend PDF QC appsettings
description: Configuration for Watch-QCTrigger, Run-QCProcessor, and dashboards. Full guide: docs/appsettings-reference.md

$schema.description: IDE link to this schema file (ignored by the pipeline).

credentialPath.description: Path to PW credential file (not committed to git).

clearTriggerTagOnSuccess.description: Remove QC_Archivist from description after successful QC_PREPEND.

fileOpThrottleMs.description: Minimum ms between PW file operations.

roots.description: Discover CADD/Sheets under each project root.

sheetsPathFromProject.description: Suffix under each project, usually CADD\Sheets

projectDepth.description: Folder levels below path that count as projects (1=direct children, 2=grandchildren).

enableQcPrepend.description: Enqueue QC_PREPEND for PDFs with QC_Archivist in description.

enableQcCommentSync.description: Allow QC_COMMENT_STATUS_SYNC from audit events on *-qc.pdf.

enableStatusSet.description: Enqueue STATUS_SET_GEN for paired sheet PDF+DGN folders.

qcRendition.description: QC_RENDITION profile for sheets under this watch root (longest matching root.path wins).

outputFolderPath.description: Absolute path to poll for rendition PDF output.

outputFolderRelative.description: Subfolder under the sheet folder (e.g. Renditions), or "." / "" to poll the sheet folder itself.

dryRun.description: Global: watcher does not enqueue jobs; processor respects processors.dryRun. Dashboard -DryRun forces true.

displayTimeZoneId.description: Windows time zone id for all pipeline wall-clock timestamps (logs, audit_events.pw_acttime, dashboards). Example: US Mountain Standard Time (Arizona). PW audit SQL bounds always use UTC.

mode.description: audit_only=audit SQL each tick + full scan every reconcileEveryNCycles; reconciliation=full scan every tick.

continuous.description: Keep one PW session open between ticks (dashboard default).

reconcileStatusSetsOnStart.description: On watcher start: upload local _StatusSet.pdf to PW (Invoke-StatusSetReconcile). Does not rebuild from sheets.

downtimeThresholdSeconds.description: hybrid/recovery: force full folder scan if audit watermark lag >= this. 0=disabled.

enabled.description: Query dms_audt on each tick (when watcher uses audit path).

lookbackSeconds.description: Steady-state capture window when no watermark file exists yet.

reconcileEveryNCycles.description: Every N watcher passes: full PW folder scan + manifest gate for STATUS_SET_GEN.

fallbackToFullScan.description: If audit SQL fails, run full folder scan that same tick.

qcPrependAuditActions.description: Audit actions on paired sheet PDFs that trigger QC_Archivist description re-read for QC_PREPEND.

workflowTriggers.description: DOCUMENT_STATE / DOCUMENT_ATTR side effects: document_state_history, transition_events, QC PDF notifications.

recordFromProcessor.description: Write document_state_history / transition_events from QC_PREPEND and comment-sync processors (no extra email; Set-PWQCWorkflowState still notifies).

recordProcessingJobs.description: Upsert processing_jobs rows with job_type QC_STATE when automation applies workflow state.

notifyOnStateChange.description: Requires notifications.enabled; fires on *-qc.pdf when qcPdfNotificationsOnly is true.

displayTimeZoneId.description: Deprecated: use runtime.displayTimeZoneId. Still read as fallback if runtime is unset.

qcWorkflow.description: Optional PW attribute/state writeback after QC_PREPEND. See docs/qc-workflow-framework.md and docs/appsettings-reference.md.

enabled.description: Master switch. false=skip all workflow writeback (safe default).

strictMode.description: If true, workflow errors can fail QC_PREPEND.

dryRunWriteback.description: Plan/log writes only; no PW changes until false.

mode.description: AttributesOnly recommended; state mode requires PW admin setup.

expectedWorkflowName.description: PW workflow name for validation when using states.

states.description: ProjectWise lifecycle state names (source of truth for QC progress).

defaultReviewType.description: Default QC_Review_Type when not set on document.

stateAfterSuccessfulPrepend.description: Fallback PW state after successful QC_PREPEND when trigger is unknown (default: Ready for QC).

defaultPrependTrigger.description: Documented default trigger key; use metadata.prependTrigger on jobs.

stateAfterPrependByTrigger.description: Maps prepend trigger keys to PW states after successful QC_PREPEND.

designerCorrectionComplete.description: Designer marked corrections complete (explicit trigger only).

attributeMap.description: Logical field → PW environment attribute name.

qcRendition.description: QC_RENDITION jobs after prepend sets Ready for QC; defers READY_FOR_QC email until rendition output exists.

enabled.description: Enqueue QC_RENDITION after successful prepend + Ready for QC state.

deferReadyForQcNotification.description: Hold READY_FOR_QC notifications until prepend and rendition both complete.

readinessStorePath.description: Directory for per-document readiness JSON files.

defaultSourceDocumentPattern.description: Get-PWDocumentsBySearch pattern when exact source name not found (default %.dgn).

deriveSourceFromQcPdf.description: Map sheet001-qc.pdf → sheet001.dgn for rendition source.

mode.description: outputFolder=poll for PDF in output folder; immediate/submitOnly=mark complete after submit.

fileNamePattern.description: Glob under output folder; {stem} from source DGN base name.

datasources.description: Deprecated: prefer projectWise.watchList.roots[].qcRendition. Keyed by projectWise.datasourceName when used.

useFolderProfileWhenUnspecified.description: Fallback to Get-PWFolderRenditionProfile when profileName omitted.

outputFolderPath.description: Absolute PW/filesystem path to poll for rendition PDFs.

outputFolderRelative.description: Subfolder under the sheet folder to poll (e.g. Renditions).

folderOverrides.description: Longest matching folderPathPrefix wins over datasource defaults.

folderPathPrefix.description: PW folder path prefix (Documents\ prefix optional).

writeBackToPW.description: Upload _StatusSet.pdf to PW after local build.

forceRebuild.description: Ignore manifest hash; always rebuild and enqueue.

incrementalMode.description: Replace only changed pages when possible.

localRoot.description: Workspace root for manifest + _StatusSet.pdf per folder.

pwSheetReusePolicy.description: Cache policy for exported sheet PDFs.

allowWritesInDryRun.description: Allow DB writes when global dryRun=true.
